title: Madagascar Country Climate and Development Report
temporal_coverage: Climate-development diagnostics and recent Grand Sud impacts reported in 2024
methodology: Country diagnostic combining climate risks, development analysis and regional vulnerability discussion.
limitations: Grand Sud impacts include pandemic, market, poverty and institutional factors; climate's causal contribution to hunger or violence is not isolated.

title: Madagascar Nationally Determined Contribution 3.0
temporal_coverage: Recent disaster and displacement information and climate projections summarized in the 2026 NDC
methodology: National contribution synthesizes climate, vulnerability and disaster information from cited studies.
limitations: French document; passages summarize cited figures, not a harmonized impact series.

title: Madagascar and the Social Impacts of Drought
organization: World Bank, Social Sustainability and Inclusion Global Practice
temporal_coverage: World Bank monitoring of the 2018-2022 drought and recovery period in southern Madagascar.
methodology: Blog summarizes four-monthly monitoring of a representative 480-person panel during 2020-2022.
limitations: Blog summary; respondent perceptions, not recorded incidence or causal effects.

title: Greening the Great South of Madagascar: How Communities Are Fighting Drought and Restoring Hope
temporal_coverage: World Bank feature on Great South climate and livelihood conditions and MIONJO results, published 2 June 2025.
methodology: World Bank project feature with local examples, project-reported restoration outputs and staff commentary.
limitations: Feature story, not a full risk assessment or independent impact evaluation; project outputs and examples are agency-reported.

title: Madagascar Advocacy Note for Humanitarian Response
temporal_coverage: Humanitarian crisis overview and response planning in the October 2025 advocacy note, including shocks from late 2024 through 2025.
methodology: Humanitarian Country Team advocacy note consolidating IPC, sector and partner situation information and response requirements.
limitations: Advocacy and needs-planning document; projections to January 2026 have since elapsed and were not outcome-verified here.

title: Speed Saves Lives: What Cyclone Gezani Reveals about the Value of Rapid and Flexible Financing for Children
temporal_coverage: UNICEF report on Cyclone Gezani's 10 February 2026 impacts and response, published 19 June 2026.
methodology: UNICEF retrospective account of reported government and partner impacts and response outputs.
limitations: Agency-reported figures; not independently audited here.
